passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.resolvedDescription: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

Q.name: Radiant Barrage
Q.resolvedDescription: Mel unleashes a barrage of 6/7/8/9/10 missiles that explode at the target location. The first time an enemy is struck, they take 60 (+25% AP) magic damage, with subsequent hits dealing {{ subsequentdamage }} magic damage each, for a maximum of {{ totaldamagett }} magic damage. If the volley hits an enemy champion at least once, this ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundchamphit }} seconds.

W.name: Rebuttal
W.resolvedDescription: Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating for 35/40/45/50/55 (+10% AP) magic damage. Subsequent retaliations against the same enemy deal {{ subsequentdamage }} magic damage instead. The nova also grants 50/80/110/140/170 (+50% AP) Shield and {{ totalms }} Move Speed for 2s to Mel and her allies.

E.name: Solar Snare
E.resolvedDescription: Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for 0.8/0.85/0.9/0.95/1 to 1.6/1.75/1.9/2.05/2.2 seconds (based on distance travelled) and dealing 60/105/150/195/240 (+70% AP) magic damage. The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by 20/25/30/35/40% and deals 16/28/40/52/64 (+8% AP) magic damage per second.

R.name: Golden Eclipse
R.resolvedDescription: Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to 60/70/80 (+10% AP) magic damage plus 3/4/5 (+0.75% AP) magic damage per stack. Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing 125/200/275 (+30% AP) magic damage plus 4/7/10 (+4% AP) magic damage per Overwhelm stack. Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.
